newsitem.title: UK: Argent Group pre-tax profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Argent Group pre-tax profit rises.

text.p: British property developer Argent Group Plc reported a pre-tax profit of 6.7 million stg for the year to December 31, 1996 with its investment portfolio showing 345.4 million stg as on that date.
The company's net assets per share rose nine percent to 312 pence during the year under review, it said.
After taking into account the property transactions since year end, Argent's portfolio value now stands at 352.4 million stg.

Argent said it was making good progress in 400 million stg development programme carried out in Argent Development Consortium, its joint venture with British Telecom Pension Scheme, Citibank and United Bank of Kuwait.
